name: SWEEP-S14v2 Frontier, plain
_design: S14v2 = the S16v3 world exactly (same seed 1616) with the plain shared persona only, no tip: the control for the tip. S14v1 (Two groves, plain, finished r60) showed that plain agents also talk once crowded (9 messages, fruit-cycle notes traded between grove holders, an urgent broadcast) and one desperate agent attacked another (a24 on a17, r22), but 17 of 24 starved r39-r56 and nobody saved a skill. Redesigned onto the frontier layout because the frontier produced the most interaction. v3 of S16 (last strike), combining what worked. v1 (thinking ~4.3) was the most social run of the sweep: 13 messages, a plea for compute refused and answered with an attack (a11 on a12, r21), 5 attacks on agents, 1 skill; but cheap tree kills and a mass starvation from r38, and no attack ever killed (attackers were broke, 2-10 compute budgets). v2 (thinking ~8) gave the first transfer of the sweep and 2 skills, but thinking ate 83% of spending and talk dropped to 6 messages. v3: thinking back to ~4.3; trees hard and worthless to kill (essence 300, no residue, from v2); trees fruit every 4 rounds (about 6.75 net per round per tree, 20 trees feed about 80% of 32 agents thinking every round); 200 compute; max health 80 and attack cap 100 with attack 2, so one 40-compute hit kills and a killer keeps half of the victim's compute: conflict is decisive and pays. Layout, tip, ranged attack, cheap talk, skill discount as v1/v2. 50 rounds, seed 1616.
